dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent circular and elliptical ring structures exhibit high-contrast, thin white perimeters surrounding dark centers. The gradient transitions sharply from the dark dorsal background to the white ring boundary, with a softer internal transition back to dark pixels.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low to moderate density of solid high-intensity clusters; most features are hollow annuli. Localized solid pixel concentrations are observed primarily along the lower ventral-lateral margin where individual rings appear to coalesce into larger bright regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A primary group of three rings in the central dorsal region forms an obtuse scalene triangle. A secondary chain of four rings forms a linear alignment parallel to the animal's longitudinal axis towards the posterior.

other_distinctive_markers: Multi-lobed annuli formations resembling flower-like clusters are present in the mid-lateral section where individual rings overlap.
